messages:
jamie: Quick check — CI failing in eng-ml/embed-batch tests. Go client returns embeddings with dim 768 for model 'open-bison-1' but our rerank path expects 1536. Tests pass in the py harness. Anyone seen streaming/auth cause truncated vectors? cc @lina

lina: Could be model variant fallback or a streaming parse bug. Which model/version is pinned in CI? Also, any auth proxy in the middle?

jamie: Pinned to open-bison-1:v2 in config. Go SDK is 0.9.2, py SDK 0.10.1. Repro locally only when streaming=true. streaming=false returns correct 1536 vectors.

arjun: Streaming in the Go client uses SSE + incremental JSON parse. If you stop reading mid-event or reconnect without clearing buffer you can end up emitting partial arrays. Also retry logic that concatenates chunks can create malformed payloads. Quick fix: validate len(vec) == expectedDim before emitting.

jamie: Thinking of patching the batch helper to either (a) fail loudly in tests, or (b) pad/truncate in prod behind a flag. Opinions?

lina: Do NOT silently pad for rerank. That affects similarity scores. For prod: drop and fallback (e.g., rerun without streaming or use model-variant). For dev/test: fail fast. Add a metric + alert on mismatch.

maria: Also check auth TTL. We recently had the internal API key proxy refresh tokens every 10m; when that happens mid-stream the Go SSE lib closed the connection and client reconnected without clearing the previous buffer. If the reconnect merges buffers you get garbage arrays. Which auth mode is CI using?

jamie: CI uses the API key from the proxy (10m TTL). Switching to client creds for CI is annoying. Any short-term SDK workaround?

arjun: We can make the Go SDK buffer until a full JSON object is parsed and only emit then. If reconnect happens, clear the buffer before reading new stream. I'll prototype. Also add a flag in batch helper: `BatchAllowPad` (default false). If false -> emit error on mismatch. If true -> pad/truncate (but warn).

jamie: Good. I'll open a CI PR adding the test that simulates chunked/truncated SSE. Also please add the dim-mismatch metric so we can alert.

arjun: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/452 — adds robust buffer parsing, validation, metric `embed_dim_mismatch_count`, and config flag `BatchAllowPad` default false. Includes unit that feeds partial chunks.

maria: Deployed canary to staging with the PR. Will monitor for 30m.

jamie: Example validation snippet I'm thinking of:

```
if len(vec) != expectedDim {
  log.Errorf("embed dim mismatch %d != %d", len(vec), expectedDim)
  metrics.Inc("embed_dim_mismatch_count")
  if cfg.BatchAllowPad {
    vec = pad(vec, expectedDim) // risky for rerank
  } else {
    return fmt.Errorf("embed dim mismatch: %d vs %d", len(vec), expectedDim)
  }
}
```

lina: Also note: rerank pipeline L2-normalizes vectors before scoring. If you pad with zeros, normalization can mask the bug in some cases, making it harder to detect. Keep the alert and fail-fast default.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for go-sdk/pr-452

maria: Canary passed for 30m :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout complete for go-sdk@pr-452 — status: success — duration 00:32:14

jamie: Thanks all. I'll update the python harness to test streaming path too and add an integration that simulates auth refresh mid-stream. Ping me if rerank scores look off after this.
